# v0.8

Released 2026-11-03. The first tagged release.

## Highlights

- First packaged version of the unofficial Zwift snap: installs Zwift on first run through
  the graphical installer and launches it with Wine.
- Yad-based progress dialogs, audio routed to the host over PulseAudio, and the workshop
  definition used to build it.
